title: British and French governments release UFO files

tellings.quote: I remember in 20072 2008 there was a release of previously classified documents of the British government the French government

plain: Around 2007 and 2008 the British and French governments released UFO documents that had previously been classified. The UFO investigator and filmmaker James Fox recalls this to Michels from memory as a moment he lived through, without saying what was in the files. He brings it up as a sign that other governments were opening their records.
